The Rise and Fall of D.O.D.O.

By: Neal Stephenson, Nicole Galland

Narrated by: Laurence Bouvard, Shelley Atkinson, Laural Merlington, Joe Barrett, Will Damron, Luke Daniels

Fantasy / Sci-Fi / Time Travel

An expert on ancient languages is recruited into a shadowy organization to study old texts that state magic is real... Or was. As they unravel the mystery of why magic no longer exists and the organization grows they recruit a theoretical physicist who thinks he can build a machine that will make magic work again. Now all they need is a witch. So parts of this story are very good, a lot of really interesting ideas. Large portions of the book feel like the story drags on unnecessarily. I have noticed this with other books by Neal Stephenson. The narration was superb with a varied cast of characters telling the story from different points of view. This is a longer audiobook coming in at 24 and a half hours. Some people love Neal Stephenson's writing, I'm not one of them. Anyway...

6.5/10
